x_query.oql:
works where date >= (2015-01-01)
  and date <= (2026-08-31)
  and full text has (
    (
      5G or 6G or B5G or RAN or stemmed "5G-Advanced" or stemmed "IMT-2030"
      or stemmed "base station" or stemmed "cellular network"
      or stemmed "radio access network" or stemmed "telecom tower"
    )
    and (
      MPC or stemmed "co-optimization" or stemmed "coordinated control"
      or stemmed "distributed control" or stemmed "integrated energy management"
      or stemmed "measurement and verification"
      or stemmed "model predictive control" or stemmed "multi-asset"
      or aggregation or coordination
    )
    and (
      stemmed "AI data center"
      or stemmed "AI data centre"
      or stemmed "cloud computing facility"
      or stemmed "data center"
      or stemmed "data centre"
      or stemmed "edge data center"
      or stemmed "edge data centre"
      or stemmed "high performance computing"
    )
    and (
      stemmed "carbon-aware"
      or stemmed "clean energy matching"
      or stemmed "renewable energy matching"
      or stemmed "renewable integration"
      or curtailment
    )
  )
x_query.url: /works?filter=from_publication_date:2015-01-01,to_publication_date:2026-08-31,fulltext.search:5G|6G|B5G|RAN|%225G-Advanced%22|%22IMT-2030%22|%22base station%22|%22cellular network%22|%22radio access network%22|%22telecom tower%22,fulltext.search:MPC|%22co-optimization%22|%22coordinated control%22|%22distributed control%22|%22integrated energy management%22|%22measurement and verification%22|%22model predictive control%22|%22multi-asset%22|aggregation|coordination,fulltext.search:%22AI data center%22|%22AI data centre%22|%22cloud computing facility%22|%22data center%22|%22data centre%22|%22edge data center%22|%22edge data centre%22|%22high performance computing%22,fulltext.search:%22carbon-aware%22|%22clean energy matching%22|%22renewable energy matching%22|%22renewable integration%22|curtailment&per_page=10
